text: No, there is no tree-cover loss candidate on this property after 2020. The latest observed tree-cover loss event occurred in 2025, which is outside the timeframe of interest (after 2020). The 2025 event affected 13.5 hectares of the asset, but this is not relevant to the question about changes after 2020. The property had 227.1 hectares of forest cover in 2020 (65.71% of the asset), and the data does not indicate any tree-cover loss events between 2020 and 2025.
